title: Transport-rule exfiltration
summary: An attacker with Exchange admin rights creates an organization-wide transport rule that blind-copies mail to an outside address.

steps.title: Starting assumption
steps.text: The attacker controls an Exchange administrator account and wants to capture mail across the whole organization at once.

steps.title: Organization-wide transport rule created
steps.text: The attacker creates a transport rule that blind-copies messages to an external address for every mailbox. One change captures the entire mail flow.
steps.whenFixed: The rule creation is written to the audit log and surfaces for review.

steps.title: Company mail copied out
steps.text: Mail for all users is now silently copied to the attacker. The volume of external mail rises sharply.
steps.whenFixed: The outbound spam alert flags the surge of external mail so responders can act.

outcome.prevented: The transport-rule change is recorded and the external surge is alerted for fast removal.
outcome.notPrevented: All company mail is copied out of the tenant through a single hidden rule.
